text.value: Consent re-confirmed for the MoCA assessment?
Please draw a line, going from a number to a letter in ascending order. Begin here [point to (1)] and draw a line from 1 then to A then to 2 and so on. End here [point to (E)].
Copy this drawing as accurately as you can, in the space below.
Cube Copy (3D, all lines, no extra lines, parallel lines)
Draw a clock. Put in all the numbers and set the time to 10 past 11.
Clock - Numbers (all 12 present, correct order, correct quadrants)
Clock - Hands (two hands, 10:11, hour hand shorter, centered)
Beginning on the left, point to each figure and say: Tell me the name of this animal.

This is a memory test. I am going to read a list of words that you will have to remember now and later on. Listen carefully. When I am through, tell me as many words as you can remember. It does not matter in what order you say them.
Words: FACE, VELVET, CHURCH, DAISY, RED
I am going to read the same list for a second time. Try to remember and tell me as many words as you can, including words you said the first time.
I will ask you to recall those words again at the end of the test.
I am going to say some numbers and when I am through, repeat them to me exactly as I said them. Sequence: 2 1 8 5 4 (1 digit/sec).
Now I am going to say some more numbers, but when I am through you must repeat them to me in the backwards order. Sequence: 7 4 2 (1 digit/sec). Correct backward: 2-4-7.

I am going to read a sequence of letters. Every time I say the letter A, tap your hand once. If I say a different letter, do not tap your hand. Letters: F B A C M N A A J K L B A F A K D E A A A J A M O F A A B (read at 1/sec).
Count by subtracting seven from 100, and then keep subtracting seven from your answer until I tell you to stop. (Max 5 subtractions: 93, 86, 79, 72, 65)
Repeat: I only know that John is the one to help today. (Must be exact)
Sentence 1: I only know that John is the one to help today. (Exact)
The cat always hid under the couch when dogs were in the room. (Must be exact)
Sentence 2: The cat always hid under the couch when dogs were in the room. (Exact)
Tell me as many words as you can think of that begin with the letter F. No proper nouns, numbers, or same-sound-different-suffix words. 60 seconds.
Practice: Tell me how an orange and a banana are alike. If concrete, prompt once: Tell me another way. If not fruit, say: Yes, and they are also both fruit.
Ruler - Watch (conceptual: measuring instruments/measure = 1 pt; numbers = 0)
I read some words to you earlier, which I asked you to remember. Tell me as many of those words as you can remember.
Tell me the date today. If incomplete, prompt for year, month, exact date, day. Then: Tell me the name of this place, and which city it is in. No points if off by one day.
Upload the completed paper MoCA sheet (image or PDF). Add more than one if needed.
Upload clear photo of MoCA sheet. Accepts JPG, JPEG, PNG.
Upload PDF of MoCA sheet. Accepts PDF.
